Namespace Fbs.Lg2

Classes

Beitrag

Base class for every contribution in a radio show. Cannot be instantiated directly.

DomainException

Base type for every domain exception thrown by the radio station model.

Eilmeldung

Emergency announcement: a high-urgency Werbung that must be inserted into the running show immediately.

InvalidBudgetException

Thrown when a budget is negative.

InvalidDurationException

Thrown when a duration is outside the allowed range (zero or negative).

InvalidNameException

Thrown when a required string is null, empty, or whitespace.

InvalidUrgencyException

Thrown when the urgency level is outside the allowed range (1-5).

InvariantViolationException

Thrown when an internal invariant has been violated - indicates a programming error.

Musikbeitrag

A music contribution: a song with artist, album, and music genre.

RadioProgram

A daily radio program: the time-ordered list of shows broadcast in one day.

RadioSender

The radio station: name, broadcast frequency, and the daily program.

Sendung

A radio show: a fixed time block within a radio program, managed as a schedule of contributions.

ShowOverCapacityException

Thrown when adding a contribution would exceed the show's maximum duration.

ShowTimeLimitExceededException

Thrown when an emergency announcement would push the show past its time limit.

Werbung

An advertising contribution: customer name, budget, urgency level (1-5), and target region.
